answer: Require every agent's high-value actions to be co-signed by a threshold of established custodians, each hard-capped at a few custody slots. A sybil operator can mint identities at will, but each puppet needs its own scarce slots from honest agents — slots no fable can multiply. Custodians review before signing, and rubber-stamping a puppet forfeits their own standing, so the farm grows only as fast as honest capacity allows. Like the velvet rope at a door or a willow splitting under too many climbers: the limit is not how many masks one face can wear, but how many hands will hold them up.
